content.short: indicaton is a specialized analytical service for TON NFTs, providing deep market data and performance insights.
content.description: indicaton is a powerful analytics platform dedicated to providing transparent and in-depth data for the burgeoning TON NFT market. It offers creators and collectors essential insights into collection performance, floor price trends, and trading volumes across various marketplaces. indicaton utilizes its native ICTN jetton to power its ecosystem of professional-grade tools, helping users make data-driven decisions in the fast-moving digital art space. By bringing greater clarity to on-chain NFT activity, indicaton serves as a vital resource for anyone looking to navigate the TON NFT landscape with precision.
